title: Prophecies of the Messiah
subtitle: Seventy major Old Testament prophecies, each connected to the New Testament passage that records its fulfillment.
hint: Hover a scripture reference to read it. Click a reference to open it on lds.org. On a phone, tap a reference to read it, then tap Open on lds.org. Hover a curve to see the prophecy that ties the two passages together.
kicker: Old Testament prediction  ·  New Testament fulfillment
dotsNote: Every label is a scripture passage, in canonical order. A curve connects an Old Testament passage to each fulfillment passage cited for it. Color matches the fulfillment book. Select a book in the legend to show only those curves.
footnote: Psalm 110, “The Messiah will return to preside over Judgment Day,” is cited to Daniel 7:13–14 and Daniel 12:1–2 as a future fulfillment. Those Daniel passages are listed at the bottom of the fulfillment column.
